name: io.github.marcello-pichini/ai-science-tracker
title: AI Science Tracker
description: Search curated catalogs of AI-enabled scientific discoveries and AI-found vulnerabilities.

tools.name: search_discoveries
tools.description: Find scientific discoveries by words in the title, field, organization, AI technology or summary. Terms match the start of a word, fold plurals and word endings, ignore accents and British/American spelling, and expand common abbreviations (LLM, ML) and variants (Nasca/Nazca, Herculaneum/Ercolano). Use English words, or paste a DOI to find its record. Common words such as "how" or "new" are ignored; if no record matches every term, a longer query returns the records matching most of them, flagged partial_match. Title matches rank first. Filter by year, field (see list_fields) or organization. Page with offset. Results include a stable ID, short summary, source and catalog link. Use get_discovery for evidence and limitations.

query.description: English topic words (for example "protein structure prediction") or a DOI. Omit to list by filters only.

year.description: Publication year of the result, 2020 or later.

field.description: Catalog field such as "medicine" or "materials"; list_fields gives every name.

organization.description: Words from an organization name, for example "DeepMind" or "University of Toronto".

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List the catalog fields (for the search_discoveries field filter) with their record counts.

tools.name: get_discovery
tools.description: Retrieve a public scientific discovery by its stable ID, including its original source, summary, evidence and caveats.

id.description: Stable discovery ID as returned by search_discoveries, for example "2020-11-alphafold-casp14".

tools.name: search_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Find publicly disclosed software vulnerabilities whose discovery involved AI, a collection kept separate from the scientific catalog. Terms match words in the title, product, AI system, organization, CVE IDs, summary and AI role, with the same matching rules as search_discoveries. Paste a CVE ID to find its case. Filter by disclosure year or AI system. Results include the stable ID, CVEs, remediation status, source and case page. Use get_vulnerability for the AI role, CVSS, impacts and caveats.

query.description: English words (for example "OpenSSL memory corruption") or a CVE ID such as "CVE-2026-34197".

ai_system.description: Words from the AI system name, for example "Big Sleep", "Claude" or "Codex".

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: get_vulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve an AI-found vulnerability case by its stable ID, including the AI role, sources, CVSS, impacts, remediation and source-attributed caveats.

id.description: Stable case ID as returned by search_vulnerabilities, for example "cve-2026-34197".
